description: This file implements command-line argument parsing and discovery logic for the 'openclaw-mac' application on macOS. It defines options handling, performs device discovery asynchronously, and outputs the discovered gateways either as formatted text or JSON.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Represents command-line options for the discovery command, including parsing logic.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Encodable structure for JSON output of discovered gateways, including nested Gateway class.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput.Gateway
classes.description: Represents individual gateway details in discovery output.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a DiscoveryOptions instance.

methods.name: runDiscover
methods.description: Main asynchronous function to perform device discovery based on command-line options and output the results.
